methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: VERYSchool proposes a software solution for establishing and maintaining an effective EnMS

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/software design paper: it describes the VSNavigator software and an "OS Catalogue" of energy conservation measures for school buildings. KPIs/EPIs, IPMVP and a calibrated building-simulation model are mentioned only incidentally; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach given).

paper_type.evidence_quote: VSNavigator, a web based Energy Navigation tools

stage1.notes: Application context is school buildings (out of 3B scope regardless). Ineligible under the v2.3 threshold as software/tool design with no characterised EnPI/EnB model.
